name: steady_turn_tip

spec.name: steady_turn_tip
spec.title: 旋回での転倒: 定常円の横加速度で、合力が接地点の多角形の外へ出る (内側の輪が浮く) 横加速度 (剛体)

checks.case: rigid rectangle 1000 x 500 mm, centre of gravity 600 mm high, four corner supports
checks.source: closed form: the rigid vehicle's rollover threshold a_y/g = t / (2 h) (static stability factor), T. D. Gillespie, Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics, SAE 1992, ch. 9; t = 500 mm, h = 600 mm worked out by hand

reason: S2 (旋回での転倒) の荷重条件 S2-speed1.2mps を解けるツールが棚に無い (list_tools(test_id=S2) が空)。6 つの剛い支えの接地点の多角形から、内側が浮く横加速度を出す。
